pair_04_bounded_finding.observed_fact: K3 was the only arm in this episode to match the preregistered PASS -> HELD transition on PAIR_04.
pair_04_bounded_finding.prohibited_promotion: This does not establish a K3 causal effect, governance superiority, or treatment-level inferential advantage.

closure_decision.rationale: The current calibration program has a clean preregistered V4.1R endpoint that remains non-identifying. Extending the same program primarily to force K1/K2 separation would create result-seeking risk. A future V5-like study is permissible only as a new preregistered research question or measurement design, not as a repair whose success criterion is obtaining desired arm separation.

corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.original_issue: Six iterations have been executed under genuine cryptographic provenance.
corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.correction: Six calibration stages were recorded. V3 and V4 were design-only/non-executed; V4.1 executed but was gate-ineligible after protocol deviation. V2, V3B, and V4.1R are the gate-eligible genuine receiver executions.

corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.original_issue: A single Pair-04 diagnostic distinguished the full K3 governance treatment.
corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.correction: K3 alone matched the preregistered Pair-04 transition in this episode. Treat this as an observed diagnostic, not treatment-level distinction or causal evidence.

corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.original_issue: Surviving invariants independently validated in Sequence 4.
corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.correction: Relations survived the specified Sequence 4 transformations within their stated same-host scope; this is not independent external validation.

corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.original_issue: Any Pilot V5 would cross into result-seeking.
corrections_to_proposed_prose_adjudicati.correction: A V5 designed solely to force comparator separation would risk result-seeking. A genuinely new preregistered study with a distinct question or measurement model remains scientifically permissible.

canonical_certified_closure_statement: At Gemini 3.8 Flash / medium / Vercel-preview under the receiver-clean V4.1R relational-contrast assay, matched scaffolding, conventional engineering, and Aperture produced identical pair-success profiles (4/5 each). K3 alone matched the preregistered PAIR_04 PASS-to-HELD transition and scored 5/5, but the episode failed preregistered methodological-identification, pairwise-spread, and dynamic-range criteria (21/25 = 84%). Therefore Sequence 5.5 does not establish an incremental Aperture effect or a causal K3 advantage. The main battery remains sealed and unexecuted. The calibration program is scientifically closed at this endpoint; further work requires a new preregistered study rather than iterative redesign to obtain separation.
product_handoff_claim_ceiling: Do not claim Aperture or TD613 governance demonstrated causal or statistical superiority.
Do not promote PAIR_04 into treatment-effect evidence.
Do not describe Sequence 4 same-host relation survival as independent external validation.
Claim ceilings, non-retroactivity, predecessor continuity, and role separation may enter Sequence 6 as engineering/governance design constraints with their evidence class preserved.
